vocabulary.meaning_en: reserve a seat on a plane
vocabulary.example: I need to book a flight to Paris.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a journey made for work
vocabulary.example: She is on a business trip in Dubai.

vocabulary.meaning_en: going away from home
vocabulary.example: What is the outbound date?

vocabulary.meaning_en: coming back; a ticket there and back
vocabulary.example: The return flight is at 6pm.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the more expensive, comfortable seats on a plane
vocabulary.example: The director always flies business class.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the cheapest seats on a plane
vocabulary.example: We'll fly economy to save money.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a ticket you cannot change
vocabulary.example: A fixed ticket is cheaper.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a ticket you can change
vocabulary.example: Buy a flexible ticket in case the meeting moves.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a seat next to the plane window
vocabulary.example: I'd like a window seat, please.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a seat next to the passage between rows
vocabulary.example: An aisle seat is easier if you need to stand up.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a membership number for people who fly often with an airline
vocabulary.example: Have you got a frequent flyer number?

vocabulary.meaning_en: an electronic ticket
vocabulary.example: Your e-ticket has been sent by email.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an official document for travelling to other countries
vocabulary.example: Don't forget your passport.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person or company that arranges travel for you
vocabulary.example: I used to book my flights at a travel agent's.

vocabulary.meaning_en: on the internet
vocabulary.example: We book everything online now.

vocabulary.meaning_en: enter a computer system or website
vocabulary.example: Let's log on and look for flights.

vocabulary.meaning_en: during the night; for one night
vocabulary.example: Are we staying overnight?

vocabulary.meaning_en: an airport shop where you pay no tax
vocabulary.example: She bought biscuits in the duty-free shop.

vocabulary.meaning_en: finally win an agreement
vocabulary.example: They flew to France to clinch the deal.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money or a card that the company pays with
vocabulary.example: Pay for the tickets using the company account.

vocabulary.meaning_en: choose (formal)
vocabulary.example: Please select your seats.

fine_lines.title: window seat vs aisle seat
fine_lines.explanation_ar: window seat بجانب النافذة، وaisle seat بجانب الممر بين الصفوف.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A window seat is next to the window. An aisle seat is next to the passage between rows.

examples.sentence: I like a window seat to see the view.
An aisle seat is good if you have long legs.

fine_lines.title: fixed vs flexible
fine_lines.explanation_ar: fixed ticket لا يمكن تغييرها وهي أرخص، وflexible ticket يمكن تغيير موعدها وهي أغلى.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A fixed ticket cannot be changed and is cheaper. A flexible ticket can be changed and costs more.

examples.sentence: This fixed ticket can't be changed.
I bought a flexible ticket so I can change the date.

fine_lines.title: business vs economy
fine_lines.explanation_ar: business class أغلى وأكثر راحة، وeconomy class هي الأرخص.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Business class is more expensive and comfortable. Economy class is the cheapest.

expressions.phrase: What is the outbound and return date?
expressions.meaning_en: When do you go and when do you come back?
expressions.example: What is the outbound and return date? Monday and Wednesday.

expressions.phrase: Do you want to fly business or economy?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل تريد السفر على درجة رجال الأعمال أم الدرجة السياحية؟
expressions.meaning_en: Which class of seat do you want?
expressions.example: Do you want to fly business or economy? Economy, please.

expressions.phrase: Do you want a fixed or flexible ticket?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل تريد تذكرة ثابتة أم مرنة؟
expressions.meaning_en: Can the ticket be changed or not?
expressions.example: Do you want a fixed or flexible ticket? Flexible, please, in case my plans change.

expressions.phrase: Would you like a window or aisle seat?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل تفضّل مقعدًا بجانب النافذة أم بجانب الممر؟
expressions.meaning_en: Where do you want to sit?
expressions.example: Would you like a window or aisle seat? An aisle seat, please.

expressions.phrase: Have you got a frequent flyer number?
expressions.meaning_en: Are you a member of the airline's club?
expressions.example: Have you got a frequent flyer number? Yes, here it is.
Your flight is at 8am. Don't forget your passports.
I've never booked online. Can you help me, please?

grammar.title: Choice questions with or
grammar.explanation_ar: نعرض خيارين في سؤال واحد باستخدام or: Do you want X or Y? / Would you like X or Y? والجواب يكون بأحد الخيارين وليس yes أو no.
grammar.explanation_en: Offer two choices with or: Do you want X or Y? / Would you like X or Y? Answer with one choice, not yes or no.
examples: Would you like a window or aisle seat? — Aisle, please.
Do you want to fly business or economy? — Economy.
Do you want a fixed or flexible ticket? — Fixed.

grammar.title: Would you like...? vs Do you want...?
grammar.explanation_ar: Would you like أكثر تهذيبًا ورسمية من Do you want، لذا يستخدمها موظفو الخدمة مع العملاء.
grammar.explanation_en: Would you like...? is more polite and formal than Do you want...?, so staff use it with customers.
examples: Would you like a window seat?
Would you like to pay by card?

questions.question: The "outbound" date is the date you...
Which ticket can you change?
questions.explanation_en: A flexible ticket can be changed.

questions.question: Which seat did Anna ask for?
questions.explanation_en: Anna asked for an aisle seat.

questions.question: The cheapest seats on a plane are ___ class.
___ you like a window or aisle seat?
questions.explanation_ar: Would you like هي الصيغة المهذبة.
questions.explanation_en: Would you like is the polite form.

questions.question: How do you answer "Business or economy?"
questions.explanation_ar: نجيب عن سؤال الاختيار بأحد الخيارين.
questions.explanation_en: Answer a choice question with one of the choices.

questions.question: A membership number for people who fly often is a ___ number.
questions.explanation_ar: frequent flyer number رقم المسافر الدائم.

questions.question: Which question is the most polite?
choices: Would you like a window seat?
questions.explanation_en: Would you like is most polite.

questions.question: "Clinch the deal" means...
questions.explanation_ar: clinch the deal تعني حسم الصفقة.
questions.explanation_en: It means finally win the agreement.

questions.question: A shop at the airport where you pay no tax is a ___ shop.
